+class TestLinuxHardwareSysinfoFacts(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_file_lines', return_value=[
+        'Manufacturer: IBM', 'Type: 3931', 'Sequence Code: 0000123456',
+    ])
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists',
+           side_effect=lambda path: path == '/proc/sysinfo')
+    def test_dmi_facts_use_sysinfo_when_dmi_is_unavailable(self, mock_exists, mock_lines):
+        module = Mock()
+        module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+        hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module=module)
+        facts = hardware.get_dmi_facts()
+        self.assertEqual({key: facts[key] for key in (
+            'system_vendor', 'product_name', 'product_serial', 'product_version', 'product_uuid',
+        )}, {
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM',
+            'product_name': '3931',
+            'product_serial': '123456',
+            'product_version': 'NA',
+            'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=False)
+    def test_absent_sysinfo_returns_no_facts(self, mock_exists):
+        hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module=Mock())
+        self.assertEqual(hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {})
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_file_lines', return_value=[
+        'Manufacturer: IBM',
+        'Type: 3931',
+        'Sequence Code: 0000123456',
+        'Unrelated: ignored',
+    ])
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=True)
+    def test_sysinfo_populates_identifying_facts(self, mock_exists, mock_lines):
+        hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module=Mock())
+        self.assertEqual(hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM',
+            'product_name': '3931',
+            'product_serial': '123456',
+            'product_version': 'NA',
+            'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_file_lines', return_value=['Manufacturer: IBM'])
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=True)
+    def test_missing_sysinfo_fields_stay_na(self, mock_exists, mock_lines):
+        hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module=Mock())
+        self.assertEqual(hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM',
+            'product_name': 'NA',
+            'product_serial': 'NA',
+            'product_version': 'NA',
+            'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
